get.summary: Lightweight endpoint the frontend calls on mount to confirm the current
get.description:
Lightweight endpoint the frontend calls on mount to confirm the current
subdomain maps to a known tenant. tenantResolver returns 404 with
error:tenant_not_found before this handler runs if the subdomain is
unknown, so a 200 here means the tenant is valid.

get.summary: Returns true when at least one active summary row exists for this email
get.description:
Returns true when at least one active summary row exists for this email.
Only active account memberships are counted — inactive accounts must not
allow login, matching the behaviour of discoverAccounts.

post.summary: Create a one-time OAuth code after IdP success (used by OAuthHandlers redirect)
post.description:
Create a one-time OAuth code after IdP success (used by OAuthHandlers redirect).
Internal route — consumed in-process by OAuthHandlers via the module client.

post.summary: Apple sends the OAuth response as POST (form-urlencoded) to the redirect URI
post.description:
Apple sends the OAuth response as POST (form-urlencoded) to the redirect URI.
Parse the body and continue as GET so Passport can complete the flow.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the broker built the payload

signature.description: hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${canonicalPayload}` using OAUTH_BROKER_SHARED_SECRET; canonicalPayload = provider,id,email,name,given_name,family_name,picture joined with newline (see AuthenticationService)

adminUser.description: The created admin user (sensitive fields stripped).

cloneStats.description: Statistics about the database clone operation.

targetDatabase.description: Name of the newly created tenant database.

collectionsSkipped.description: Total number of collections skipped (shell-only or excluded).

desiredSubdomain.description:
Desired subdomain / account key.
Must be 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only,
cannot start or end with a hyphen.

adminPassword.description:
Admin user's initial password.
Defaults to the platform-wide known default (ACCOUNT_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env var, or the hard-coded fallback). The caller of this service is
responsible for communicating the password securely.

databaseInstanceName.description:
Override the MongoDB database name used for this tenant.
Defaults to the desiredSubdomain value.

databaseInstanceHost.description:
MongoDB host/connection string for the tenant database.
Defaults to the same connection string as the enterprise (Core) database,
i.e. the default shared cluster.

originDatabaseName.description:
Name of the origin (template) database to clone.
Defaults to ORIGIN_DATABASE_NAME env var, or "Origin".

skipClone.description:
Skip database cloning entirely.

Use when the target database has already been seeded externally — for
example via `snapshot-create.mjs` + `full-migrate.mjs`.  The service
will still register the account in Core and create the admin user; it
will NOT touch the target database collections.

When this flag is set, `cloneStats` in the result reflects zero
collections / documents and a negligible duration.

apiKey.description:
The full plaintext API key — returned ONCE at creation and never again.
Format: `ent_<accountKey>.<keyId>.<secret>`.
